plugins.name: vcollab
plugins.description: Work with engineering simulation results from a conversation. This plugin connects Claude to the VCollab installation on your Windows computer, so Claude can inspect native CAE, CAD and JT files, convert them to VCollab's compact CAX format, merge CAX files, render result images, and run VCollab Pro XML batch jobs. Everything runs locally against files you name; nothing is uploaded by the plugin.

plugins.name: cae-viewpoint-report
plugins.description: Review a VCollab .cax model and get three files: a viewpoint Markdown report written with the CAE-expert review method, a CAX with one rich PPT-style viewpoint per slide (title bar, text and tables, charts, verified probes) and a WCAX with the same viewpoints. Builds run in the background with your local VCollab Pro 26.1+ on Windows; nothing is uploaded by the plugin.
